correction_mode: append-only: the confirmation file is left byte-identical on disk and in git history; this file records the accurate content beside it

defect.cause: the confirming script looked for a table named 'charges'. The frozen V152 budget store writes attempt rows to a table named 'attempts', so the query silently returned nothing. The table inventory at confirmation time was ["metadata", "tasks", "attempts"]
defect.why_it_matters: an empty attempts list in a blocked-round record could read as 'nothing was charged', which is false; the round did consume one authorized model construction

no_computation_change: this correction reads the ledger and git only. It reserves no budget, runs no model forward, and does not alter the R or B BLOCKED status recorded in the confirmation.
